ideas.pitch: A natural language compliance copilot that surfaces real-time AML and liquidity risk signals, merging transaction data with policy text to produce audit-ready findings.
ideas.problem_statement: Risk, Fraud and Regulatory Intelligence Copilot
ideas.title: RegiRisk Snowflake Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly attacks the real-world relevance judging criteria by automating manual compliance workloads and producing evidence-backed answers.

ideas.pitch: Unifies customer policy records with unstructured call transcripts inside Snowflake to generate churn reduction scores and next-best-action recommendations in a single view.
ideas.problem_statement: Customer 360 and Next Best Action Engine
ideas.title: NextBestAction 360 Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages technical execution and solution completeness to solve the universal business pain of siloed customer touchpoints.

ideas.pitch: Converges real-time IoT sensor streams with ERP maintenance records on Snowflake to predict equipment failures and drive natural language root cause investigations.
ideas.problem_statement: Predictive Maintenance and OEE Command Center
ideas.title: OEE Command Center for Manufacturing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves hard engineering problems involving multi-source data convergence (IT and OT data) for tangible economic impact.

ideas.pitch: Combines structured healthcare records with dense unstructured regulatory documents to produce risk stratification and cited clinical answers without opaque predictions.
ideas.problem_statement: Patient and Member 360 and Clinical or Regulatory Document Copilot
ideas.title: Clinical & Regulatory Document Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates strict evidence-backed RAG transparency, directly satisfying the judging focus on solution completeness.

ideas.pitch: Encodes core supply chain entities and canonical metrics into governed semantic views on Snowflake, letting cross-functional teams query performance consistently.
ideas.problem_statement: Supply Chain Ontology and Governed Conversational Analytics
ideas.title: Supply Chain Ontology Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses data governance and cross-department consistency, making it extremely relevant to enterprise judges looking for production-ready designs.
